Edition compass · Case 04 · Die andere Stadt · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Opportunities, risks and countermeasures

Editorial initial classification for the model case before additional measures. Plausibility is not a measured probability; effect means the benefit in terms of opportunities, an undesirable consequence in terms of risks. Unexplained conditions remain outside the quadrants. The exploration and theme maps explain additional dependencies.

Working together

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect limited

With introduction and a manageable process, a profit in everyday work can be easily achieved. It concerns first of all cooperation, not all open questions of the project.

How does Git help? Git keeps track of changes and supports joint review.

Action: Pilot together and test the manual with new employees.

Responsible for: Project management and technical team

Import losses

Risk · low plausibility · far reaching effect

After the agreed import acceptance new full imports are less frequent. Overwriting a genetic markup, nevertheless, a large part of the edition work can be affected.

How does Git help? Comparison and version history show lost structures.

Action: Target later reading corrections; repair the converter in case of systematic error.

Responsible for: Import responsibility and specialist editorial

Own research

Chance · Plausibility higher · Effect far reaching

Lukas and Nora are already working on their own questions. Understanding research stands can strengthen both their dissertations and the joint edition in the long term.

How does Git help? Own referenced research collections and comparisons keep the reference comprehensible.

Action: Hold down base release and stable identifiers; set up suitable research repos.

Responsible for: doctoral researchers and project management

New findings

Opportunity · plausibility less · effect far reaching

A fundamentally different chronology is open. If it occurs, it can simultaneously change edition, interpretation and interface; the follow-up effort remains to be considered.

How does Git help? Alternative stands can be examined and taken over in a controlled manner.

Action: Expert discussion of findings; schema, data and presentation together.

Responsible for: Specialist editorial, researchers and technology

Rate corrections

Risk · Plausibility higher · Effect limited

Individual deviations between set and download are obvious in the correction process. Their scope is initially limited to affected areas; without regulated return flow they can expand.

How does Git help? Named delivery and reference levels document the return flow.

Action: Arrange correction package and accept technical changes checked in TEI.

Responsible for: Editing and publishing

Publication

Opportunity · plausibility less · effect far reaching

Early feedback can significantly improve usability. Whether a suitable inventory can become public early on still depends on publishers and researchers.

How does Git help? Partial releases combine precisely defined data, functions and test benches.

Action: Arrange a release plan with content, responsibility, operation and next expenses.

Responsible for: Specialist editorial, researchers, technology and publishing

Access to research

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

The positions are expected to end before the dissertations. An access interruption is therefore plausible and can significantly affect the independent further work.

How does Git help? Authorized copies and designated base stands allow independent further work.

Action: Before posting the new role, allow copies and access practically check.

Responsible for: Nora, project management and institutional administration

Technical assistance

Risk · low plausibility · far reaching effect

The failure of a key person is not foreseeable. Without proven representation, however, he can hit import, tests and front-end operation at the same time.

How does Git help? Versioned procedures and documentation make knowledge transferable.

Action: Set up representation and have a second person perform the restoration.

Responsible for: Technical team and institutional support

Further work

Risk · Plausibility higher · Impact far reaching

Less secure working hours are available after the end of the funding period. Lack of post-editing or support may therefore affect several expenditures and subsequent corrections.

How does Git help? Tested stands limit rework and help with the handover.

Action: early agreement on tasks, responsible persons and realistic post-financing capacity.

Responsible for: Project management with publishing house and library
